trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the problem regarding the refund deduction and provide the lead ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, माझा एक refund चा problem आहे. तुम्ही माझ्या refund मधून पैसे का cut करत आहात? माझा lead id LD-2003 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the user's issue and set expectations for checking details.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी तुमची नक्कीच मदत करतो. एक मिनिट द्या मला, मी details check करतो.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details using the provided lead ID.
Return booking details.
Inform the user about the payment found and explain the next step to check eligibility.
steps.text: तुमच्या unit C-0501 साठी 300000 payment झाले आहे. Deduction का झाले आहे हे समजून घेण्यासाठी मी तुमची refund eligibility check करतो.

steps.purpose: Check the refund eligibility and exact deduction applied to the booking.
Return refund eligibility and deduction details.

result.reason: Provisional allotment cancellation after 15 days incurs 15% deduction

steps.purpose: Explain the deduction reason and amount based on the eligibility tool result.
steps.text: माहितीनुसार तुमचे allotment provisional आहे, आणि payment करून 20 दिवस झाले आहेत. Policy नुसार 15 टक्क्यांचे deduction लागते, जे 45000 आहे. म्हणून तुम्हाला 255000 refund मिळेल.

steps.purpose: Confirm the deduction amount and ask for clarification on the domain terminology.
steps.text: म्हणजे माझे 45000 cut होतील? पण हे provisional म्हणजे नक्की काय? मला ते समजत नाहीये.

steps.purpose: Clarify the domain terminology 'provisional' in simple terms for the user.
steps.text: हो, 45000 cut होतील. Provisional म्हणजे तुमचे booking temporary होते, पूर्ण confirm झाले नव्हते. त्यामुळे हे deduction लागू होते.

steps.purpose: Agree to cancel the booking and ask for the processing time using pronouns.
steps.text: अच्छा. ठीक आहे, मग cancel करा ते. आणि त्यासाठी किती days लागतील?

steps.purpose: Answer the processing time question and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: Refund process व्हायला 10 processing days लागतील. Process सुरू करण्यापूर्वी, तुम्ही तुमचे registered नाव आणि pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested identity verification factors with an STT phonetic substitution error.
steps.text: माझं नाव रमेश आहे, आणि pincode 411038 आहे.
steps.clean_text: माझं नाव रमेश आहे, आणि pincode 411038 आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: माझं नाव रमीज आहे, आणि pincode 411038 आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name and pincode.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and inform the user that the refund is being initiated.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची माहिती verify झाली आहे. मी तुमचा 255000 चा refund initiate करत आहे, कृपया थोडा वेळ द्या.

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund for the cancelled booking.
Return the initiated refund details.
Provide the refund ID to the user.
steps.text: तुमचा refund initiate झाला आहे. Refund ID RF-1029 आहे. हा ID लिहून घ्या.

steps.purpose: Confirm writing down the ID and ask for the exact amount and time, refusing to use the app.
steps.text: लिहून घेतला. I cannot check on the app. तुम्ही सांगा exact किती मिळणार आणि कधी.

steps.purpose: Confirm the exact refund amount and processing time without making any unsupported guarantees.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the exact amount and processing days as returned by the tools, and explicitly refuses to guarantee a faster timeline.
steps.text: तुम्हाला exact 255000 मिळतील. System मध्ये 10 processing days दाखवत आहे, मी त्यापेक्षा लवकर मिळेल अशी guarantee देऊ शकत नाही. App check करायची गरज नाही, amount थेट तुमच्या account मध्ये येईल.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the response entirely in the tool output, ensuring no false promises are made about the refund timeline.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
